data.name: Rakhamah
data.gender_notes: Rakhamah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Rahmah' which means 'Grace', 'Compassion' and 'Mercy'. This name is often given to girls to signify the best of these virtues. The name Rakhamah carries the meaning “Grace, Compassion, Mercy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rakhamah usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, compassion, mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the spirit of kindness, compassion, and mercy. It is a reminder to always be gracious and merciful towards others.
data.etymology: Rakhamah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, Compassion, Mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rakhamah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name provides a constant reminder of the importance of showing kindness, forgiveness and offering support to those in need.

It serves as a reminder of His infinite compassion and grace, and the importance of extending this mercy and compassion to others. By giving this name to a girl, her parents are instilling the virtues of compassion, kindness and mercy within her, encouraging her to become a beacon of Allah's love and care in the world.
